items.title: COP31 climate talks fail to reach an agreement on fossil fuel language
items.excerpt: U.N. climate talks collapsed over whether to mention fossil fuels that cause global warning. Several countries and the E.U. would not accept a final proposal without this.

items.title: Perspective: A hero's name lives on
items.excerpt: During Pearl Harbor, sailor Doris Miller carried the wounded to safety and fired a machine gun at Japanese planes. Next week, construction of a new aircraft carrier, the USS Doris Miller, begins.

items.title: An explosion at a school in eastern Afghanistan kills 10, wounds 110
items.excerpt: Local officials said the blast appeared to have originated in a neighboring depot for mining explosives.

items.title: New wave of Democratic attorneys general may reshape the justice system
items.excerpt: The Democratic victories could have major effects for what alleged crimes are investigated, lawsuits filed and court cases heard across the U.S.

items.title: Sudan's lost generation: War is stealing the childhood of millions
items.excerpt: Three years of war have stolen childhood from millions of children in Sudan, leaving them displaced, hungry and fighting for survival instead of learning in a classroom.

items.title: Thanksgiving storm batters East Coast. And, Black Friday sales to hit record levels
items.excerpt: A powerful storm knocked out power for nearly 1 million customers and flooded streets. And, experts predict inflation will not dampen American spending for the holidays

items.title: French cinema star Gérard Depardieu ordered to stand trial for rape and sexual assault
items.excerpt: The case has become one of the most prominent in France's reckoning with sexual violence, as the #MeToo movement has faced resistance in the country, particularly in the arts.

items.title: From Thanksgiving blackouts to Black Friday, a holiday hit by wild weather and economic woes
items.excerpt: A storm battered much of the country on Thursday, knocking out power to thousands of homes and disrupting travel. Today, Black Friday shopping deals kick off, and on Saturday New York City will hold the postponed Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade.

items.title: Can luxury save Macy's?
items.excerpt: This week's celebration of Macy's 100th Thanksgiving parade finds the department store at a turning point. After years of losing sales, the retailer is reimagining itself — as a higher-end destination.

items.title: Trump effectively ended asylum. Advocates look to the Supreme Court to restore it
items.excerpt: Trump's sweeping immigration changes — an asylum ban, mass firings and new legal maneuvers — have all but ended asylum. The high court will soon consider whether some shifts deny people due process.
